reports.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Jailed 200 Years Over Deaths of 190 Children | NewsX World
reports.description:
A Kenyan court sentenced cult leader Paul Mackenzie to 200 years in prison over the deaths of 190 children who prosecutors said were starved or killed under his orders. The Shakahola Forest case has become one of Kenya’s most shocking mass-death investigations.
